notes.title: ∀kashicforce ver. 1.04 Live, Soundtrack Added in ∀kashibox vol. 2!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34696857/1b5d389c51956ba171745d7fb2264884deebb9c4.png
Good news everyone! ∀kashicforce has now been updated to version 1.04, and by popular demand, the game's awesome soundtrack has been made available in the ∀kashicbox vol. 2 DLC!

Version 1.04 changes
Added new art from art contest winners to the Twitter post feature.
Added a new main menu option to open game manual.
Adjusted character balance.
Fixed various bugs.

∀kashibox vol. 2
∀kashicbox vol. 2 contains 3 stunning soundtrack discs and a Sound Matrix minigame which lets you play tracks in the "Eliminator" rhythm game mode from the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1067340/kashicbox_Vol2

∀kashicbox vol. 2 contains a total of 30 tracks in .wav format, including the theme song of the game, Shapeless Flower / Katachi no nai Hana.

It is also available in a new ∀kashic Bundle with an additional -10% discount for owners of the game!

Thank you for all the support!

notes.title: ∀kashicforce Art Contest!
notes.content:
Hello all players! We're happy to announce an art contest for ∀kashicforce!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34696857/90767fb73a1dea2cb1e6e48787bb1974add95629.png

The game includes a function where you can post results on Twitter. The Steam release version now also adds a random fan art when you do so!

We're now announcing a fan art contest - simply post a fun art featuring any of the characters in the game either in the community artwork section, or on Twitter with the tag #Akashicforce by April 14, and Endless Shirafu may add your art to the game to be used with this function!

Basic contest rules
Draw an original art featuring one or more of ∀kashicforce characters, and post it either on the community art section or on Twitter with the hashtag #Akashicforce.
Submission period: open now, until April 14, 8AM PST!
Winning art doesn't need to be in a specific resolution, but it will be adjusted to 1024x768 pixels.
Endless Shirafu will pick winners to be included in version 1.04 of ∀kashicforce!

We hope you'll enjoy the contest!

Disclaimer
By submitting an Entry, the Entrant grants Fruitbat Factory, Ltd and Endless Shirafu a perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free worldwide license under all copyrights, trademarks, and other intellectual property rights to use, publish, distribute, copy, modify, translate, create derivative works based upon, make available and otherwise exploit such Entry. Fruitbat Factory, Ltd and Endless Shirafu may do so in any media formats and channels, in any number of copies, without further notice to Entrant, and without the requirement of permission from or payment to Entrant. In addition, Entrant agrees that Fruitbat Factory, Ltd. and Endless Shirafu may use any ideas from any Entry, whether or not Entrant has been awarded a prize in connection with any such Entry.

notes.title: Brave Insanity in ∀kashicforce!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34696857/9ae491f2b600bfa8ec448fffd5db736c21b6513d.png
We're happy to announce that Endless Shirafu's hectic puzzle/rhythm/fighting game ∀kashicforce is now available to play!

Game Features
A unique mix of different game genres
6 playable characters
Local split-screen multiplayer
English and Japanese language support
What madness awaits those who touch the forbidden flower...? Dive into the story mode and prevail against all odds!

∀kashicforce is -10% off during launch week - join the fun today!
